decisions.reason: F11 falsely identified the positive side independently of the derivative sign (P=-y is a counterexample). Repaired 8.1 using the analytic inverse of (x,P_j-t_j) on a rectangle, whose positive and negative half-rectangles have connected images. Also repaired 3.1: the tubular neighborhood is bounded by max_{K_j}|w|+delta_j/2, not by the norm of an arbitrary fixed point. The rational least-index selections and compact critical-value argument preserve the choice-free exhaustion and the Statement is unchanged.

The density, total mass, compact-support Cayley substitution, O(1/N) compact tail bound and boundary arctangent limits are sound. The asserted exclusive use of AC_omega was false: F6 and step 4.2 explicitly use the AC_omega harmonic-limit interface. Corrected the choice-use accounting in Example, Given and 6.1 without changing the assumed axiom or any analytic conclusion. No Statement/Definition section exists in this example, so its frozen section hash is unchanged.

False positive: page means the composed library page, whose items list includes thm-green-function-exists-on-bounded-plane-domains. Its steps 1.4, 2.1-2.3, 3.1, 4.1, 4.2 and 5.1 prove respectively the regular boundary limit, Perron construction and leastness, strict positivity and the 2pi distributional normalization. Step 4.2 uses the actual Dirac theorem in addition to the defining PDE kernel. The definition itself only specifies nonnegative candidates and pointwise leastness; it does not assume these later results. The punctured-disc alternative candidates have harmonic added log(1/|z|). No edit is warranted.

The cited annulus definition explicitly permits R=infinity. Then the domain is exterior, there is no outer boundary circle and log R is not real. Added R<infinity in Example and Given, as required for the intended two-circle claim. For finite 0<r<R, the two explicit logarithmic barriers vanish only at their chosen circle point; the radial harmonic function has continuous boundary values 1 and 0, so Perron uniqueness gives the stated complementary probabilities under the declared DC assumption. No Statement/Definition section changed.

The definition supplies nonnegativity, which already suffices for disc leastness: U+log|w| is at least log r on |w|=r, hence nonnegative after r tends to 1. Replaced the stronger unsupported positive-candidate wording in F1 and 2.2 by nonnegative. The logarithmic corrector extends through the simple zero, and F3 now obtains harmonicity of Re L=log|q| directly by the declared log-modulus and composition results. Rotation invariance and the AC-for-existence-only claim remain sound; Statement unchanged.

Pullback by f and f^{-1} preserves nonnegativity and harmonicity; the simple-zero factorization changes the logarithmic pole by the harmonic Re L. Thus each pullback is a candidate and leastness gives both inequalities without strict positivity or any boundary extension. Corrected F1, 2.1 and 3.1 to nonnegative; supplied the C2 hypothesis in F3 explicitly using the already-declared holomorphic smoothness result in F2 at 1.1. The Statement is unchanged.

F6 omitted the C2 hypotheses of the components theorem used in 2.1. Added the published holomorphic smoothness supplier, explicitly established both components are C2, and cited the C2 subharmonicity criterion for the harmonic peak. The bound q<=-sqrt(rho)/sqrt(2) supplies the strict smaller-neighborhood bound, giving regularity. Reflection of the zero-trace Green function in a smaller pole-free chart yields C2 correctors; their derivatives agree from inside on overlaps. Statement and Countable Choice assumption are unchanged.

F12 assigned zero trace to the Perron corrector instead of g. Repaired it to trace h_a=-log|xi-a|, consistent with 3.3 and H_a=h_a/(2pi). The volume-potential argument has the correct sign Delta V=-f and u=H_boundary+V for f=-Delta u. Also restored the missing 2pi in the polar bound J_0, supplied C2 holomorphic components in the dense-class reflection argument, justified positivity of ball measure via polar coordinates, and corrected choice-use accounting. Bounded f, joint continuity off the diagonal and uniform logarithmic tails justify Fubini, continuity and zero boundary limits. All Statement clauses are unchanged.
